# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting viral internet culture through Know Your Meme's meme encyclopedia and Scientific American's science journalism and documentary initiatives.

This site combines meme documentation and cultural analysis from Know Your Meme (covering TikTok trends, exploitable formats, and viral phenomena) with Scientific American's science content and subscription offerings. The content spans internet culture, social media trends, and scientific communication.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral video documentation
- Internet culture analysis
- Social media platforms (TikTok, Twitter/X, YouTube)
- Meme origins and spread
- Pop culture references
- Scientific journalism
- Documentary filmmaking
- Wildlife conservation
- Catchphrases and dialogue memes
- Dance memes and challenges
- Nostalgia-driven content
- Mental health humor

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi...](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Explainer on viral Nasra Ahmed ICE detention incident memes from Minneapolis

## Viral Meme Documentation

- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring heartbreaking art from DeviantArt artist t-a-t-k-a
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman exchanges

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Curated collection of relatable mental health and depression humor memes

## Scientific American Content

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans: digital & print access pricing
- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): $80K grant for wildlife conservation documentary films on endangered species
